This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
ORDER 1.
The applicant has filed this fourth bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 05.06.2023 by Police Station- Pathariya, District Vidisha in connection with Crime No.02/2018, registered for offence punishable under Sections 305, 376(2)(N)(I), 376(2)(F) of the IPC and Sections 3/4 and 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
2. It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that applicant has already suffered confinement for almost 19 months as pretrial detention.
Learned counsel for applicant referred the statements of parents of the prosecutrix/deceased to submit that they have nowhere implicated the present applicant in their court statement.

sentences.text: Although, DNA report indicates that applicant and prosecutrix were in relationship, however relationship was consensual in nature.
Looking to the period of custody and status of trial, applicant may be released on bail.
Earlier, applicant was released on bail but because of absence on a fateful day, he could not appear before trial court

,
therefore, arrest warrant was issued and he again suffered more than four months of incarceration.
Applicant bears no criminal record.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial.
He further undertakes not to be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant party in any manner.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.
3 . Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and looking to the period of custody and status of trial, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
